facts.fact: At the 30 June 2026 session the APD took decisions on its agenda, which included authorisation requests (AOUN data access for TAAZOUR, SAMU caller geolocation, SEHATY insured data), the data-hosting coordination with AN-ETAT and IMT, and ministries' compliance answers under its BEYANAT-HIMAYE programme; the page does not state the outcomes.
